verdict.rationale: Unleash's environments concept lets teams enable flags in dev/test without affecting production, and API tokens/backend tokens are scoped to a single environment, effectively providing environment isolation for testing (unleash-docs-10, unleash-docs-21, unleash-docs-15). However, there is no explicit 'sandbox mode' or dedicated non-production testing environment marketed for AI-native agents, and the MCP server integration for AI agents (unleash-docs-7) doesn't specify environment restrictions to prevent touching production data. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test environment guarantee for AI agents, documentation tying MCP-driven flag creation to non-production scopes, and independent verification that environment isolation fully prevents production impact.
